items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: Well, well with Bob and Bob Aran and a little fella called Little Sheik used to play at the palace.

ctx.x: Who were some of the outstanding drummers when you were young?

Well, well with Bob and Bob Aran and a little fella called Little Sheik used to play at the palace. He used to call him. And Little Big Big. I know you know him. He plays up and down all the time. Chinese Big Big.
